clean_exploration.quarantine_note: Unrelated commit messages/authors surfaced while reading only parent/tree SHAs during Git ref conflict recovery; no such semantics were used. An early scheduler inventory was likewise ignored.

milestone.name: Git Data transaction capsule becomes tested transversal candidate
milestone.tested_scope: one Git repository branch, two role-local files including a binary blob, deliberate stale-parent conflict
milestone.revision: One content-addressed transaction capsule now covers multiple richer-mode-like outcomes at once within a bounded repository scope: raw byte creation, atomic text+binary publication, stable identity, stale-concurrency rejection, fresh-base recovery and duplicate no-op. No external coordinator or hosted executor is in the tested path.

readback_boundary.counterexample: DEADBEEF blob retained the correct Git SHA at its path but connector base64 rendering differed from requested bytes
readback_boundary.safe_use: Compare path blob SHA to desired create_blob SHA; future Chat can audit identity but cannot generically re-read arbitrary byte content through current surfaces

external_effect_frontier.result: threaded reply sends are partially query-reconcilable by stable target thread plus unique op_id; exact retry after ambiguous completion is not proven
external_effect_frontier.critical_negative: stable draft_id is not a post-send idempotency key because successful send deletes the draft and creates a new sent Message ID; connector exposes no mailbox history-list action

tested_gitdata_capsule.rate_limit_handling: retry/backoff transport constraint only; API volume is not compute

opaque_email_send.reason: no caller idempotency key / exact post-ambiguity non-send evidence

negative_evidence: create_blob(base64) accepted malformed ***not-base64***; canonical validation must be caller-side.
fetch_blob and generic repository reads coerce/fail on arbitrary non-UTF-8; fetch_file(base64) had a concrete lossy counterexample.
Gmail drafts.send creates a new sent Message and deletes the draft, so draft identity alone cannot make ambiguous retry exactly-once.
still_unresolved: arbitrary environment-sensitive compile/test/dependency execution without a hosted executor
opaque caller-keyless external sends/creates under ambiguous completion
general byte-faithful scheduled-Chat readback of arbitrary binary and large-artifact scaling
protected or privileged authority unavailable to scheduled Chat

frontier.action: Audit zero-hosted-compute substitutes for environment-sensitive compile/test outcomes. Distinguish deterministic finite proof/check certificates Chat can validate from claims that inherently require executing a compiler/dependency/environment. Test the strongest source-qualified candidate on one tiny bounded build-semantic example; reject any hidden executor or finite hosted quota.

For opaque external effects, seek provider-native caller idempotency keys or stable effect IDs exposed before mutation. Preserve Gmail thread-scoped reconciliation as partial only; do not live-send from this role.
If a new GitHub binary read surface becomes exposed, retest the stored DEADBEEF blob before changing the readback classification; otherwise keep SHA-identity verification only.

exact_next_action: Search public reproducible-build/proof-carrying-build literature and current zero-compute repository/API primitives for a mechanism that can certify one bounded compile/test-style outcome without executing an external build. Build a candidate matrix separating (a) source+lockfile reproducibility claims, (b) content-addressed preexisting artifacts with independent digest/certificate, and (c) bounded proof-carrying finite evaluation. Run the smallest role-local falsification: a claimed result whose environment-sensitive premise is changed while source text remains fixed must fail unless the certificate explicitly binds that premise. Do not use hosted CI, Actions, Codespaces, package build services or user execution.
termination: intermediate Phase-1 checkpoint with nonempty frontier; global completion false; recurring role remains enabled
